events.title: Electron 1.0 released
events.summary: GitHub released Electron 1.0 on May 11, 2016 — a stable [API] for building desktop apps with Chromium, Node.js, and web technologies.
events.about: Electron (`BrowserWindow`, `ipcMain`) packages [HTML]/CSS/JS as native apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux — VS Code, Slack, and Discord all use it. Born as Atom Shell for the Atom editor, it made cross-platform desktop development accessible to web developers.

narrative.whyChosen: Electron 1.0 marked desktop web apps as a mainstream deployment target.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved Chromium + Node could ship production desktop software at scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Cross-platform desktop UIs required separate native codebases or immature web wrappers.
